title: Chapter 249 Mysterious Enemy
content:
Chapter 249 Mysterious Enemy

My own home?

Qin Feng was slightly stunned when he heard Lu Xue's words.

And when he reacted, he was shocked.

Your own home!

Is this magnificent and domineering supreme city below your home? !

Qin Feng felt a little incredible, then slowly turned his head to look at Xiao Luo on the side.

He knew that Lu Xue's origin must be very difficult, but he never took the initiative to understand it.

He believed that with his relationship with Lu Xue and Xiao Luo, he would know sooner or later.

Now, I didn't expect to know it in this way.

Xiao Luo looked calm and patted Qin Feng's shoulder with a face he had known for a long time.

"Brother Qin, be calm, be calm."

Hearing this, Qin Feng smiled bitterly.

I was just shocked.

After all, at first, Qin Feng would think that Lu Xue must be the proud daughter of a terrifying force in the fairyland.

He never thought about the Wood Fairy Realm at all.

At the same time, Ao Qing twisted his huge body and had already arrived on the void of the deserted city. The next step was to enter the city.

At this moment, a sword light suddenly soared into the sky above the walls of the deserted city.

Seeing this scene, the people in the city nodded in a clear way.

"Here appears, that sword holder from the deserted city!"

Someone from the fairyland spoke.

He also came from the Immortal Realm from a long distance to the Wood Immortal Realm to specially watch Master Qiao’s alchemy competition.

Because he came early, he learned about some things in the deserted city.

For example, that sword light.

The sword holder in Huangcheng was of unknown strength. He once slashed a powerful Immortal Emperor realm with one sword, shocking the whole city.

Now, when seeing the sword-holder in Huangcheng taking action again, for some reason, everyone in the city suddenly became a little excited.

But in the deserted city, the indigenous people looked at the outsiders in front of them with a sarcastic look on their faces.

Haha, a bunch of local buns, I don’t know anything.

Can Lord Huang Shou take action against Lord Ao Qing?

Who is Lord Ao Qing? He is Miss Lu Xue’s personal expert. It is said that he has saved the lady from danger countless times.

Even the city lord praised him very much.

Sure enough, the shocking war that everyone wanted to see did not appear, but saw the sword light stopping in front of the dragon and slowly turning into a sword-holding man.

The next moment, the man holding the sword bowed respectfully to the head of the giant dragon in shocked eyes and said, "Wang Shou, I have seen the lady."

At this time, everyone noticed the figure above the leader.

Two men and one woman.

Miss?

Just as everyone was confused, the entire Huangcheng City Lord's Mansion suddenly began to shake.

The next moment, several terrifying auras soared into the sky, turning into several streams of light, and flew straight into the void of the deserted city.

The law of forbidden air in the void faded away like a tide with the arrival of these auras.

In an instant, several figures appeared on the void of the deserted city, facing the giant dragon from afar.

"I'll wait, I've seen the lady!"

Several figures whispered loudly, accompanied by a terrifying aura, shattering the entire void.

Below, in the deserted city.

The cultivators from all over the world looked at the dozen terrifying figures in the void and their bodies were trembling.

Is this the strength of Huangcheng?

It's really scary.

The breath of every figure is so unfathomable.

In the void, above Ao Qing's head.

At this moment, Qin Feng and Xiao Luo were already at a loss, and Xiao Luo was a little better.

Now that their Xiao clan is powerful, he can still withstand such a scene.

But Qin Feng was a little panicked. He had never seen this scene when he walked from a small place to Tiandi Academy.

Looking at Lu Xuedi's back blankly, Qin Feng suddenly felt that Lu Xue's image had become much more majestic.

Lu Xue also looked at the people in front of her, her face turned a little red.

"Master, what are you doing?"

Lu Xue said with a slightly shy face.

As for such a big battle.

Although I do want to be more high-profile, this is a bit too high-profile.

However, Ao Qing under her seat seemed a little excited.

"My little master, what's the matter? Looking at the whole world, who else in this world has more noble status than you? This is what you deserve!"

Opposite, Gu Chen and others smiled.

"Xiaoxue, this is all prepared by the city lord for you."

"father?"

Lu Xue is speechless.

What is my dad going to do?

Looking down at the direction of the Lord of the Huangcheng City Mansion below, seeing that there was no movement there, Lu Xue pursed her lips and then prepared to enter the city.

And at this moment, the mutation broke out!

A terrifying breath suddenly came from the sky, tearing apart the void, turning into a huge palm and capturing towards Lu Xue in the void.

The speed was extremely fast, and in an instant he had already arrived above Lu Xue's head.

At this moment, Gu Chen and others were stunned.

Someone dared to attack Miss Lu Xue at this time? !

But the opponent took action too quickly, so fast that they could only watch Lu Xue coming into danger, but they were helpless.

I can't react at all.

The gap is really too big!

At this critical moment, an angry shout suddenly sounded from the lord's mansion in Huangcheng City.

The whole world suddenly changed.

"presumptuous!!"

boom!

The terrifying attack flew out of the Lord of the Huangcheng City Mansion and instantly repelled the giant hand.

Taking advantage of this gap, Gu Chen and others were quick-witted and quickly brought Lu Xue, Ao Qing and the others into the deserted city.

At the same time, the entire deserted city fell into the highest alert.

Countless terrifying auras turned into light curtains and flowed around the outer edge of the deserted city.

A large number of strong men appeared in the city, each of whom was unfathomable, staring at the sky full of murderous intent.

"Shit, what happened?"

For a moment, the people in the deserted city had not yet figured out what was going on.

But the solemn atmosphere around them made them feel a little chilled.

Somewhere in the city.

Jordan Yang was also staring at the void, his eyes full of fear.

What a terrifying aura.

Is that the enemy of the deserted city?

The strength is definitely far above the Immortal Emperor Realm.

I don’t know if Huangcheng can survive this disaster.

If you can't get through it, then you will not have the need to refine alchemy here.

"Damn it, I'm scared!"

Beside Lu Xue, Qin Feng covered his chest and gasped.

He didn't even know what was going on just now, but he seemed to see his too much breasts.

Now I feel the horror just now.

Just now, I really walked through the gates of hell.

Xiao Luo, who was beside him, couldn't help but tremble all over.

That aura was much more terrifying than the ancestor of their Xiao clan.

I am still too weak now and have no power to resist at all.

"Miss, are you okay?"

An Xing and others immediately stepped forward to check Lu Xue's situation, fearing that something would happen to Lu Xue.

Fortunately, Lu Xue was just a little scared.

"Master, what is that? Why do you attack me?"

Lu Xue, who had recovered from his senses, suddenly said indignantly.

Whoever you ask for provokes you.
